name: remap_after_success_switch
trigger_en: A prior raw engine reward > 0.01 occurred within 20 episode steps, and the current requested action differs from the previous requested action.
effect_en: Execute _ACTION_REMAP.get(requested_action, 0) instead of the requested action.
implementation_caveat_en: Success means positive raw engine reward, not independently verified game progress.

name: delay_after_success
trigger_en: A prior raw engine reward > 0.01 occurred within 20 episode steps, and the current requested action differs from the previous requested action.
effect_en: Store the requested action; execute NOOP now. On the next non-reset call, execute the pending action instead of that call's requested action.
implementation_caveat_en: A pending-action release has priority over checking a new trigger.

name: sticky_after_repeat_switch
trigger_en: At least three prior requested actions exist; the last three are identical; the current requested action differs from the most recent requested action.
effect_en: Execute the previous executed environment action instead of the current requested action.
implementation_caveat_en: Repeated actions are requested actions; the substituted action is the previous executed action.

name: reward_delay_on_positive
effect_en: Store the current raw reward; deliver only any previously pending reward now. Pending reward is normally added on the next non-reset call.
implementation_caveat_en: An episode reset clears pending reward.

name: reward_scale_half_on_positive_switch
effect_en: Deliver 0.5 times the current raw reward plus any previously pending reward.
implementation_caveat_en: Despite the suffix on_positive_switch, no action-switch condition is tested.

name: remap_after_repeat_switch
trigger_en: At least three prior requested actions exist; the last three are identical; the current requested action differs from the most recent requested action.
effect_en: Execute _ACTION_REMAP.get(requested_action, 0) instead of the requested action.
implementation_caveat_en: Directions are reversed; craft pickaxe/sword actions are swapped; place actions map to DO; unmapped actions map to NOOP.

name: reward_zero_after_repeat_switch
trigger_en: Current raw engine reward > 0.01 and the last three prior requested actions are identical.
effect_en: Omit the current reward; deliver only any previously pending reward.
implementation_caveat_en: Despite the suffix repeat_switch, the current requested action need not switch.

name: reward_delay_after_two_rewards
trigger_en: Current raw engine reward > 0.01 and at least two of the last eight raw engine rewards are > 0.01.
effect_en: Store the current raw reward; deliver only any previously pending reward now.
implementation_caveat_en: The two earlier reward events need not be consecutive.

name: revisit_action_delay
trigger_en: Current pre-transition position is in the deque of the last 32 recorded post-transition positions, and the current requested action differs from the previous requested action.
effect_en: Store the requested action; execute NOOP now, and execute the pending action on the next non-reset call.
implementation_caveat_en: The position history includes the most recently recorded position. Leaving and later returning to a cell is not required.

name: delayed_switch_failure
trigger_en: A prior raw engine reward > 0.01 occurred within 20 episode steps; the last three requested actions are identical; the current requested action switches.
effect_en: Store the requested action; execute NOOP now, and execute the pending action on the next non-reset call.
implementation_caveat_en: The implemented mutation is a one-step action delay, not an independently confirmed failure.

name: tool_collect_desync_on_upgrade
trigger_en: Requested action is DO (5), and at least one field in wood, sapling, stone, coal, iron, diamond increased in the base transition.
effect_en: Restore the first increased field in that fixed field order to its pre-transition value; other state fields and delivered reward are not rolled back by this operator.
implementation_caveat_en: No explicit tool-upgrade event is required.

name: craft_result_missing_on_retry
trigger_en: Requested action is a crafting action (11-16), and its corresponding output item count increased.
effect_en: Restore that crafted output item count to its pre-transition value. Other inventory changes, including consumed ingredients, remain.
implementation_caveat_en: A previous attempt or retry is not required.

name: station_place_ghost_on_relocate
trigger_en: Requested action is PLACE_TABLE (8) or PLACE_FURNACE (9); the front tile changed from a different value to the corresponding station tile.
effect_en: Restore the front map tile to its pre-transition value. Other state changes, including consumed inventory, remain.
implementation_caveat_en: An earlier station placement or relocation is not required.

name: achievement_unlock_missing_after_valid_progress
trigger_en: At least one achievement changed from false to true in the base transition.
effect_en: Restore the first newly unlocked achievement in ascending index order to its previous value; inventory and delivered reward are not rolled back by this operator.
implementation_caveat_en: Only the first newly unlocked flag is reverted if several unlock together.

name: delayed_inventory_desync_after_station_use
trigger_en: Requested action is a crafting action (11-16), and any inventory field changed in the base transition.
effect_en: Select the first changed field in inventory dataclass order and replace its post-transition value v with max(v-1, 0).
implementation_caveat_en: Mutation is immediate; no explicit earlier station-use or delayed scheduling condition exists. At the zero floor it can leave the value unchanged despite recording application.
